name: session-stats
description: Session token & performance stats: turns/steps, LLM time, TTFT, tok/s, cache hit, input/output tokens — shown via a status bar pinned to the ZCode window bottom (requires install.sh for the bar itself; this manifest provides hooks + /stats command), plus a /stats command that renders a detailed stats card in chat.

description_i18n.en: Session token & performance stats: turns/steps, LLM time, TTFT, tok/s, cache hit, input/output tokens — shown via a status bar pinned to the ZCode window bottom (requires install.sh for the bar itself; this manifest provides hooks + /stats command), plus a /stats command that renders a detailed stats card in chat.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 会话 token 与性能统计：轮/步、LLM 耗时、首 token、tok/s、缓存命中、输入/输出 token——通过固定在 ZCode 窗口底部的悬浮条展示（悬浮条本身需要 install.sh；本 manifest 提供 hooks 与 /stats 命令），另有在对话中渲染详细统计卡片的 /stats 命令。
